verdict: t_L is not 1, and it lies on both sides of 1 over the modelled set. With a cube axis on the stem's axis (θ = 0) it does not depend on the lattice's shear modulus C44 (measured for the infinite lattice by the periodic voxel case and read below); at the moistest group (95 % RH) it is 0.267–1.744 over the alloys, the material symmetrisation readings and the three pore readings, and which side of 1 it takes depends on the pore reading and on the symmetrisation reading. Off that axis C44 enters too: t_L falls as C44 rises, and at θ = 45° it crosses 1 inside the admissible C44 in 90 of the 120 cells the lattice's C44 enters. The pore readings' stiffness ends do not bracket the share (9 cell-fields fall outside them). Across the source's moisture groups the share takes no single direction. For 105, the only C44-free binding figure is at θ = 0 (E_z* = E[100] of this tensor): at the lowest θ = 0 share of the Scots pine group (Ti-6Al-4V 0.342, Ti-6Al-7Nb 0.350, CP-Ti-Gr4 0.354, beta-Ti-13Nb-13Zr 0.405, Ta 0.267, Ti-15Zr 0.360) the source day's upper whisker exceeds the large-stem threshold for Ta on this tensor's E[100] and for Ta on 105's lower reading (the radial one), and its median for none; at t_L = 1 on both readings the upper whisker exceeded it for CP-Ti-Gr4, Ta, Ti-6Al-4V, Ti-6Al-7Nb and the median for CP-Ti-Gr4, Ta. Above fibre saturation no open primary gives a full Scots pine set; on the separate group of green readings of other Pinaceae (26 live, 3 not a material) the lowest θ = 0 share is Ti-6Al-4V 0.188, Ti-6Al-7Nb 0.190, CP-Ti-Gr4 0.195, beta-Ti-13Nb-13Zr 0.221, Ta 0.151, Ti-15Zr 0.197, so over the union it is Ti-6Al-4V 0.188, Ti-6Al-7Nb 0.190, CP-Ti-Gr4 0.195, beta-Ti-13Nb-13Zr 0.221, Ta 0.151, Ti-15Zr 0.197 — on Davies, Altaner & Apiolaza 2016, N.Z. J. For. Sci. 46:19, doi 10.1186/s40490-016-0075-x, Table 2, stiff outerwood; soft reading, pores_voigt_phase_bound — and there the upper whisker exceeds the threshold for none on this tensor's E[100] and for none on 105's lower reading (the radial one), its median for none. Of the highest θ = 0 share, no green reading raises the Scots pine group's for any alloy; off the axis at C44 = 0 the union reaches 9.840 (the Scots pine group 6.040) — on Davies, Altaner & Apiolaza 2016, N.Z. J. For. Sci. 46:19, doi 10.1186/s40490-016-0075-x, Additional files 2–3, stiff outerwood; stiff reading, pores_carry_nothing, our assembly of its raw means; on the published green sets alone it reaches 7.155 — on Davies, Altaner & Apiolaza 2016, N.Z. J. For. Sci. 46:19, doi 10.1186/s40490-016-0075-x, Table 2, stiff outerwood; soft reading, pores_carry_nothing. Off the axis the swept threshold has no ceiling as C44 falls. Read on the measured C44 — the periodic voxel case's infinite lattice, 0.42–0.44 of Voigt's ceiling on its own solid fraction, Zener ratio 1.49–1.55, carried onto the part body (which has none of its own) as the absolute modulus ⊥ the Zener ratio, the material tensor read whole beside them — the threshold has a ceiling off the axis, and with the install angle free it does not rise above the θ = 0 figure on any reading, rung, alloy or group (144 of 144 readings × rungs × alloys × groups): for Ti-6Al-4V on the Scots pine group the gyroid binds above 4534 µε at most on the tensor's own E_z*(θ) (4502 on the lowest reading), the cells the lattice's C44 enters reaching 2334 µε, and on 105's radial reading, which has no off-axis counterpart, its θ = 0 figure 4610 µε stands; over every angle the share is at most 1.982 over the union, at θ = 0°, and at θ = 45° it exceeds 1 in 47–49 of the 120 cells the lattice's C44 enters. The modelled set reads the ring as the host's xylem, its Scots pine group stops below fibre saturation and its green readings are other Pinaceae, so its lowest share is not a floor.
